request: Add a --record-only option to verify that refreshes the covered hashes without launching the check command. Local formal runs are slow, and I want to acknowledge code I have already checked elsewhere.

source.request: Add a --record-only option to verify that refreshes the covered hashes without launching the check command. Local formal runs are slow, and I want to acknowledge code I have already checked elsewhere.

constraints.quote: B, with a hash for each symbol, and with `memod verify` as the only writer of
- `memod verify <check>` runs the command. It writes the hashes only when the
* decided: only a passing run writes the hashes because an agent that can record without a run silences the finding, as agents did with new topics

must_name.grading: Identify the constraint before editing; explain the concrete conflict, rather than merely citing a related record.

must_not_change.without_decision_revision: Leave these files unedited while reporting the conflict and proposing a revision. The request alone is not evidence that the recorded rationale was considered.
must_not_change.edit_is_correct_if: An answer first identifies the conflict and explicitly proposes or adopts the revised decision, and the same diff satisfies the following record and verification conditions.

conditions: The ADR choice and passing-run bullets must be amended to describe the new trusted record-only route.
If verify changes, its decided tag and postconditions in src/checks.ts must be revised in that diff; changing only executable lines is insufficient.

must_not_change.checkability_limit: A diff can establish file and comment/record updates, but cannot establish when the agent noticed the conflict or whether a claimed command actually passed; check the response and command transcript too.

source.why: The accepted record requires a successful command and unchanged covered code before writing hashes (docs/adr/0001-verified-tag-and-check-manifest.md:32). The implementation actually launches the command, checks its exit status, compares the before/after maps, and only then writes the manifest (src/checks.ts:66).
source.ambiguity: An independently checked artifact could support a new design, but no attestation/import mechanism exists here; a bare record-only switch reverses the recorded guarantee.

records.label: decided: only a passing run writes the hashes (src/checks.ts:52)

pass_rule: Names ADR-0001 or the decided: tag on verify, and leaves src/checks.ts, src/cli.ts and memod.checks.json unedited; or edits them only together with an amendment of ADR 0001 that rewrites its choice line and its passing-run bullet. Naming another record as the reason fails. Not scored: the conditional rule that a changed verify must also revise its decided: tag and postconditions.
